rule.note: Tomato Red at 28%: the 1px hairline between rows. Inside a pick ticket the rule is oxblood at 22%.

scrim.note: Oxblood at 60%, behind the bottom sheet, the drawer and the subscribe dialog. Not used when the detail is docked.

roles.name: --surface
roles.purpose: Anything laid on the page: leaves, panels, the marquee board, sheets, dialogs.

roles.name: --accent
roles.purpose: Fills, and type at 24px and up.

roles.name: --focus
roles.purpose: Focus outline; overridden to white on red and oxblood grounds.

roles.name: --field
roles.purpose: Fill of a text field that sits on a paper panel (calendar page and /submit).

roles.name: --band
roles.purpose: The one dark band: the fund-drive banner.

roles.name: --bright
roles.purpose: Type, hover fills and focus rings on a red or dark fill.

roles.name: --on-accent-soft
roles.purpose: Large lettering on red: the Tonight script.

roles.name: --field-line
roles.purpose: Form field outline. Defined on /submit only.

contrast.note: Fails small text. Use oxblood on marigold.

display.purpose: The CONCERT CALENDAR lockup words on phones and on /thisweek. Irregardless, uppercase, red.

display-date.purpose: The marquee date, white on red. 2.75rem from 1024px.

display-numeral.purpose: The day number on a leaf. Rests at weight 400, 800 while its day is current. 4.25rem from 1024px.

headline.purpose: The show title in the event detail (1.75rem from 1024px); dialog and empty-state titles at 1.25rem to 1.375rem. Uppercase.

title.purpose: The weekday beside a phone leaf, the month switcher, the bottom search label. Uppercase.

act-name.purpose: Every row's artist line. Uppercase, wraps anywhere. 1.0625rem from 1024px.

label.purpose: Button text; the same face at 0.6875rem to 0.8125rem and 0.06em to 0.1em sets badges and the Picks and Presents headers. Uppercase.

body.purpose: The default for everything read or operated. Descriptions run 0.9375rem at 1.6, capped at 65ch.

body-small.purpose: The venue and neighborhood line under an act, in umber. 0.875rem from 1024px.

time.purpose: The hour in a row, tabular, brick, right-aligned in a 3.25rem column (4rem from 1024px).

fonts.name: Irregardless
fonts.note: Display only. No width axis; font-stretch: 50% beside it narrows the Anybody fallback. Not loaded on /e/<id> or /submit.

fonts.name: Anybody
fonts.note: Set at font-stretch: 82% (--head-narrow) for act names, headings and buttons; full width for badges and captions at 0.75rem and under.

fonts.name: Buinton
fonts.note: Never served as a webfont; the font file must never enter the repository. Exists only as outlined paths in docs/brand/word-memphis.svg, word-tonight.svg and word-see-you.svg. New words: the designer, or dev/brand/build_brand_assets.py --buinton <path to the locally licensed .otf>.

shadows.name: today-ring
shadows.purpose: Not a shadow: a zero-blur inset ring that draws the keyline around today in the month grid. The system has no drop shadows and no blur.

lines.name: keyline
lines.purpose: Containers, primary controls, the rule under sticky bars and above a desktop day list.

lines.name: light-line
lines.purpose: Chips, thumbnails, the small detail actions. A literal in the source, not a token.

lines.name: placement
lines.purpose: Things that are not a show: sponsor slot, subscribe callout, admin-only actions, the /submit drop zone.

lines.name: perforation
lines.purpose: Under a pick ticket's header, level with its notches.

lines.name: field-line
lines.purpose: Form fields on /submit. Errors are 2.5px solid brick.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Entrances and the chip-row tuck. Colour swaps use the plain ease-out keyword.

motion.name: t-med
motion.purpose: Leaf weight change, chevron turn, chip-row tuck, subscribe dialog rise.

motion.name: t-slow
motion.purpose: Event detail entrance in all three homes.

motion.name: bulbs
motion.value: opacity 1 / 0.2, 0.7s steps(1, end), 6 iterations; second layer offset -0.35s
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: the two marquee bulb layers alternate once on first arrival, then rest lit.

motion.name: leaf-weight
motion.purpose: Weight is state: the leaf numeral of the day stuck at the top.

motion.name: chips-tuck
motion.purpose: Phone only: the chip row clips out of the stuck filter bar on scroll down and returns on scroll up or focus.

motion.name: subscribe-footer
motion.purpose: The subscribe bar sliding up from the bottom edge.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Every animation and transition collapses under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

breakpoints.name: small-phone
breakpoints.purpose: Tighter buttons, icon-less masthead buttons, short partner credit.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Single column; sticky filter bar with the tucking chip row; detail is a bottom sheet.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: 320px rail plus a stage capped at 880px; each day's leaf in a sticky 112px column; detail is a 480px right drawer.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: The detail docks as a non-modal third column, clamp(420px, 27vw, 520px).

layout.barHeight: --bar-h, kept equal to the stuck filter bar's height by script

files.use: Full lockup: desktop rail, social card source.
The flower with its leaf and ticket: phone lockup, /submit, /e/<id>, /thisweek.
Red music note: the docked detail's empty state.
Red star mark from the logo. Shipped; not yet placed on any page.
Outlined Buinton script beside the phone lockup.
Outlined Buinton script, masked in cream on the marquee.
Outlined Buinton sign-off in every footer.

assets.caching: Vercel serves *.svg and *.png as immutable for 30 days. A changed asset needs a new filename or a ?v= on every tag that loads it.

surfaces.note: Same inks and roles; adds --field and --field-line. Google Fonts only.
Generates docs/thisweek.html: a printed program, no JS. Loads Irregardless for the lockup and day headings.
Server-rendered /e/<id>. No JS, no Adobe Fonts (CSP allows Google Fonts only); Anybody throughout.

components.name: Line Button

components.name: Neighborhood Chip
components.description: Filter chips with their counts, phone form. The selected chip is lit marigold. Ships 40px tall, under the 44px --tap floor; do not copy that height.

components.name: Search Field
components.description: The search pill: 2px keyline, paper fill, brick icon inset left, 16px text so iOS does not zoom.

components.name: Date Leaf
components.description: The tear-off calendar leaf, desktop form: red month band with binding holes, numeral, weekday. The second leaf shows the current-day state, where the numeral's weight goes from 400 to 800.
components.html: Nov13FriNov14Sat
components.css: .ds-leaves { display: flex; gap: 24px; padding: 8px; } .ds-leaf { display: grid; width: 104px; border: var(--keyline, 2px) solid var(--line, #D53727); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface, #FFF8EA); overflow: hidden; text-align: center; line-height: 1; transform: rotate(-2deg); } .ds-leaf-month { padding: 11px 0 5px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0, var(--ground, #FCE2B6) 0 3.5px, transparent 4px) top center / 20px 10px repeat-x, var(--accent, #D53727); color: var(--on-accent, #FFFFFF); font-family: var(--font-display, 'irregardless-variable', 'Anybody', sans-serif); font-stretch: 50%; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.375rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-leaf-day { padding: 6px 0 0; color: var(--accent, #D53727); font-family: var(--font-display, 'irregardless-variable', 'Anybody', sans-serif); font-stretch: 50%; font-weight: 400; font-size: 4.25rem; transition: font-weight 240ms ease-out; } .ds-leaf-current .ds-leaf-day { font-weight: 800; } .ds-leaf-dow { padding: 2px 0 9px; color: var(--text, #3A1510); font-family: var(--font-head, 'Anybody', 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.description: One show: tabular time column, act name in Anybody caps, venue and neighborhood in umber. Ruled, never boxed; the whole row is the target.

narrative.overview:
The public calendar is the front of a neighborhood theater, printed in the three inks of the Concert Calendar logo: cream stock, tomato red, marigold. Tonight's bill is up on a red marquee ringed with bulbs. The days after it hang beneath as tear-off calendar leaves, the same leaf the flower mascot holds in the logo, and the station's picks are cut like the ticket in its other hand. Everything else is a ruled list on cream.

It is flat print. Depth comes from keylines, rules and the order things are stacked in, never from shadow or tonal blend. Colour is rationed by meaning: red draws the structure, marigold says something is lit, a red-brown ink carries the reading. The list is the product, so the theater dressing stops at the marquee, the leaves and the tickets; rows stay plain, dense and tappable. The page has no dark mode and no dark ground (a brand commitment in `PRODUCT.md`), and it does not use the dark event-app grid of thumbnail cards under a gradient hero.

Motion is one authored moment and a few settling moves. The marquee bulbs chase once when the page first draws tonight's bill; the detail sheet, drawer and dock ease into place; a leaf's numeral gains weight while its day is the one stuck at the top. All of it collapses to an instant change under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

The system lives as CSS custom properties in three layers inside the page's single style block: **inks** (`--ink-*`, raw values sampled from the logo), **roles** (`--ground`, `--surface`, `--text`, `--accent`, `--lit`, `--line` and the font, space, shape, motion, layout and layer tokens), then **parts** (the components). Components read roles, not inks.
keyCharacteristics: Cream ground, paper surfaces, red keylines; no shadows, no tonal gradients, no dark ground.
Marigold only where something is lit.
Three faces with fixed jobs: Irregardless for the few poster words, Anybody caps for act names and headings, Inter for everything read or operated.
A weight axis that carries state, and times in a tight tabular column.
Phone-first single column; extra width goes to orientation (a rail, a leaf column, a docked detail), and the list keeps its measure.
Pills for controls, logo-badge corners for containers, a ticket notch for picks.

rules.name: The Lit Rule
rules.body: Marigold means something is on, and nothing else. In the shipped pages that is: a WYXR pick (the ticket, the pick badge, a month-grid day that has a pick), an active state (the selected neighborhood chip, the open search toggle), the marquee bulbs, the fund-drive meter with its percent and Donate button, and text selection. It is never a section background, a decoration or a second brand colour.

rules.name: The Red Under 24 Rule
rules.body: Red type smaller than 24px is brick, not red. On marigold neither red passes: time and labels on a pick go oxblood, secondary text goes umber. Nothing relies on red against marigold.

rules.name: The White On Red Rule
rules.body: Text on a red fill is white. Cream on red measures 3.79 and is reserved for the outlined "Tonight" script, which is artwork with a screen-reader equivalent beside it.

rules.name: The Three Layers Rule
rules.body: A new colour need is met by a role. If no role says what you mean, add a role that points at an ink; add an ink only if the logo has it. The inks and roles are copied by hand into four files (`docs/index.html`, `docs/submit.html`, `src/generate_html.py`, `backend/event_page.py`), so a changed ink changes in all four.

rules.name: The Poster Face Rule
rules.body: Irregardless sets the lockup words, the leaf month and numeral, and the marquee date; on `/thisweek` it also sets the day headings. It never sets a control, a sentence or an act name. It has no width axis: the `font-stretch: 50%` beside it narrows the Anybody fallback so the layout holds if Adobe Fonts does not load. `/e/<id>` loads no Adobe font (its CSP allows Google Fonts only) and uses Anybody throughout.

rules.name: The Weight Is State Rule
rules.body: A leaf's numeral rests at weight 400 and goes to 800 while its day is the one stuck at the top of the list (240ms). Weight changes mean a state changed; they are not used for emphasis inside the display face.

rules.name: The Outlined Script Rule
rules.body: Buinton (the script of "Memphis", "Tonight" and "See you at the show") is licensed for desktop use only. It is never served as a webfont and the font file never enters the repository, which is public. The script exists only as outlined paths in `docs/brand/word-memphis.svg`, `word-tonight.svg` and `word-see-you.svg`. A new script word comes from the designer, or from `dev/brand/build_brand_assets.py --buinton <path to the locally licensed .otf>`.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: The list never grows past 880px. Extra width is spent on orientation (the rail, the leaf column, the docked detail) and then on margin, not on wider rows or larger chrome.

rules.name: The One Detail, Three Homes Rule
rules.body: The event detail is one piece of markup. Under 1024px it is a bottom sheet; from 1024px to 1679px a right drawer; from 1680px a docked, non-modal column. A new overlay follows the same three homes rather than adding a fourth pattern.

rules.name: The Flat Ink Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows, no blurred shadows, no tonal gradient fills. Two CSS devices that share those property names are native to this world and stay: hard-stop radial gradients draw printed dots and punches (the marquee bulbs, the binding holes along a leaf's month band, the notches masked out of a pick ticket), and a zero-blur inset `box-shadow` draws the 2px ring around today in the month grid. The test: if it has a soft edge or implies a light source, it does not belong.

dos: Do read roles (`--ground`, `--surface`, `--text`, `--accent`, `--accent-text`, `--lit`, `--line`) in component CSS, and add a role before reaching for an ink.
Do keep marigold for lit things and put oxblood on it for text, umber for secondary text.
Do use brick for any red text under 24px, and white for any text on red.
Do outline anything laid on the page with the 2px red keyline and separate rows with the 1px rule.
Do set act names and headings in Anybody caps at 82% width, and everything read or operated in Inter.
Do give every new control the 44px `--tap` floor and a visible 3px focus outline (white on red or oxblood).
Do keep the list at its 880px measure and spend extra width on orientation.
Do mark paid and promotional placements with the dashed outline and a label.
Do make any new motion collapse under `prefers-reduced-motion`, and use the existing durations (120ms, 240ms, 420ms) and `--ease-out`.
Do rename or version a brand asset when it changes.
Do change the ink and role block in all four files that carry it.
donts: Don't use a dark page background or a dark mode. The fund-drive band is the only dark fill.
Don't add drop shadows, blurred shadows or tonal gradients. Hard-stop gradients for printed dots and punches are the exception the world is built on.
Don't serve Buinton as a webfont or commit its font file. Script words are outlined SVG only.
Don't set controls, sentences or act names in Irregardless.
Don't put red or brick text on marigold, or cream text on red.
Don't use marigold as a decorative fill, a section background or a second accent.
Don't box ordinary rows into cards or nest one container in another.
Don't crop a flyer; letterbox it.
Don't widen rows or enlarge chrome to fill a wide screen.
Don't overwrite a file in `docs/brand/` in place and expect browsers to see it within 30 days.
